meta.title: BaoBao & DaXing
meta.description: A draggable rounded-square buddy: BaoBao by day and DaXing by night, showing context pressure and the session task count, tracking tasks, and compacting the context on demand.

keepTasksTip: Archive the task list each turn so it survives a new turn
noSession: Start a session and I'll keep watch~
browse: Use the arrows to page through other conversations
staleTodos: Task list from the previous turn (none written yet this turn)
tip: Drag the title bar to move me; click my head to collapse/expand; ⌂ resets to the bottom-right
